# local-ai-chat-frontend

> A privacy-first, browser-only chat UI for local and remote LLM endpoints (OpenAI, Ollama, GPT4ALL, LM Studio, llama.cpp). There is no backend: all configuration, chat history, and system prompts persist to IndexedDB in the browser, and API keys never leave the device.

Runs entirely client-side (React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 7 + Tailwind CSS 4). Multiple LLM providers are supported via direct `fetch()` calls to a user-supplied endpoint, with automatic model discovery and per-model system prompts. GPT4ALL is proxied through Vite in development only, to work around its lack of CORS support; all other providers are called directly from the browser.

## Getting started

- [Run instantly with npx](https://github.com/hidao80/local-ai-chat-frontend#quick-start): `npx https://github.com/hidao80/local-ai-chat-frontend`
- [README](https://github.com/hidao80/local-ai-chat-frontend/blob/main/README.md): overview, features, supported providers, install/build/dev commands
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hidao80/local-ai-chat-frontend/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for AI coding agents working in this repository — key files, commands, code style, security constraints
- [Landing page](https://hidao80.github.io/local-ai-chat-frontend/): GitHub Pages site (this directory)

## Supported LLM providers

OpenAI, Ollama, GPT4ALL, LM Studio, llama.cpp — all via OpenAI-compatible or provider-native REST APIs, with reasoning-model support (`reasoning_effort` / `think`) where the provider offers it. See the README's provider table for default endpoints and auth requirements.
